expected.reason: Lines 343-352: BEFORE moving the freshly-downloaded temp file into its final name, every existing file whose lowercased name has the entry's lowercased displayName as a PREFIX, and is either a `.jar` or ends `.jar.disabled`, is removed -- this deliberately sweeps both the enabled AND disabled prior copies of the same plugin, not just the currently-active one, so an update doesn't leave an orphaned disabled duplicate of the old version behind.
